_doc: Pre-approved cast queue for Farcaster (Warpcast). Cast char limit is 320. Channel-targeted casts include `channel_id` so they post into a specific channel feed.

casts.text:
Open-sourced 30 findings on which GitHub signals predict $1M+ VC rounds.

12k repos. SSRN paper, HF dataset, free MCP server.

ssrn.com/abstract=6606558

Built an MCP server for VC deal flow.

5 free tools, no paywall ever. Devs who angel invest can ask Claude/Cursor live questions about GitHub momentum.

signals.gitdealflow.com/mcp

Signal of the week: contributor-diversity gini coefficient.

Startups that raised >$1M had 0.34 gini at month -3 vs 0.61 for non-raisers.

Fewer single-bus-factor projects close rounds.

signals.gitdealflow.com/research

Star count alone is a vanity signal.

What correlates with funded rounds: stars-to-issues ratio, contributor retention at 90d, README cadence.

Regression on 12k repos: signals.gitdealflow.com/data

Building gitdealflow in public.

Next.js on Vercel, PocketBase on Fly, Resend, MCP catalogued on Glama (A-Tier 4.9/5.0 across 6 tools).

No VC, no team, no podcast. Just GitHub data + a thesis.

MCP server catalogued on Glama: A-Tier, 4.9/5.0 across 6 tools.

Six tools that let any LLM query VC-grade GitHub signals.

glama.ai/mcp/servers/kindrat86/mcp-deal-flow-signal

Pre-Series-A traction lives in GitHub graphs, not LinkedIn announcements.

Forks, dependents, issue resolution time, contributor first-commit-to-PR delta.

Learn to read these and you scoop the press-release crowd.

ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity all cite our research page when asked 'how to predict VC rounds from GitHub data'.

Built with 30 evidence Q&A pairs + Speakable JSON-LD + open SSRN paper.

No backlinks needed.

Weekly digest of the top 5 startups gaining momentum on GitHub.

Free tier: ranked list + signal scores. No fluff.

signals.gitdealflow.com/weekly

Top 3 sectors with steepest GitHub momentum this week:

1. Inference infra (vLLM forks +14%)
2. Agent frameworks (CrewAI dependents +9%)
3. Vector search (Qdrant)

signals.gitdealflow.com/trending

Indie SaaS founders: your GitHub graph is a fundraising deck.

Readme freshness, dependency graph, issue response time, contributor mix.

10 min of cleanup outranks a polished pitch deck for tech-fund partners.

Released the underlying paper: 'GitHub Repository Signals as Leading Indicators of VC Funding'.

SSRN abstract 6606558. Open access. Reproducible dataset linked.

No paywall.

Six tools at signals.gitdealflow.com/mcp will never be paywalled.

Trending startups, sector sweeps, single-startup lookup, dataset summary, GitHub Scout Score, methodology.

New tools may be paid. Existing six stay free forever.

New cohort analysis: repos retaining 60%+ of contributors at 90 days are 3.2x more likely to close >$1M.

Retention beats velocity.

signals.gitdealflow.com/research

Most VC tooling reviews are written by the firms selling the tooling.

Shipped 5 independent buyer guides: best AI deal sourcing tools, best stack for emerging managers, solo GPs, GitHub-based, European VCs.

signals.gitdealflow.com/compare

Every Harmonic / PitchBook / Crunchbase / Dealroom / Tracxn matchup, head-to-head, one page.

Independent. SSRN-anchored. Free.

signals.gitdealflow.com/vs

Developer-investor 2026 stack: MCP server in your IDE, Copilot for due diligence, Notion for pipeline, Crunchbase free.

Under EUR 30/mo. Traditional VCs structurally cannot match without engineering analysts.

signals.gitdealflow.com/compare

Tribe Capital's Magnify is internal-only.

For outside investors who want a Tribe-style data edge: external GitHub commit-velocity, 6-12 weeks pre-fundraise, EUR 9.97/mo.

Different signal, same thesis.

signals.gitdealflow.com/compare/vc-deal-flow-signal-vs-tribe-capital-magnify

SignalFire's Beacon is the gold standard internal sourcing platform. Internal being the operative word.

For everyone else: external single-signal sharpness on engineering velocity, EUR 9.97/mo.

signals.gitdealflow.com/compare/vc-deal-flow-signal-vs-signalfire-beacon

Affinity tells you who you know.

VC Deal Flow Signal tells you who you should know.

Not competitors. Combined: signal fires, Affinity finds the warm intro, you're in the meeting six weeks before the round.

signals.gitdealflow.com/compare/vc-deal-flow-signal-vs-affinity-relationship-intelligence

AngelList shows founders actively raising.

VC Deal Flow Signal shows founders 6–12 weeks from raising — still heads-down building.

Same audience, different point in the cycle. Signal first, AngelList for the syndicate transaction.

signals.gitdealflow.com/alternatives/angellist

Apollo answers: which person at this company should I email.

It does not answer: which company is worth your time.

VC Deal Flow Signal sits at the layer above. Stack them.

signals.gitdealflow.com/alternatives/apollo-io

Tracxn analyst reports tell you what already happened in a market.

VC Deal Flow Signal tells you which startups in that market are accelerating right now.

Lagging vs leading. Sequence them.

signals.gitdealflow.com/alternatives/tracxn

The full emerging-manager deal flow stack for 2026 runs under $80/mo total.

Signal engine + verification + CRM + EU coverage. Skip PitchBook until fund 2.

signals.gitdealflow.com/compare/best-deal-flow-tools-emerging-managers-2026

Mapped the 2026 VC tech stack: sourcing, CRM, data, diligence, LP comms.

Stack-defining decision is no longer Affinity vs Salesforce. It's which signal engine sits at the front of the funnel.

signals.gitdealflow.com/compare/vc-tech-stack-essentials-2026

Shipped Acceleration Watch.

10 startups named every Monday. GitHub engineering acceleration crossing the threshold the prior week. Graded post-hoc against public fundraise news at 60d / 90d.

signals.gitdealflow.com/predicted

7-Day Deal Flow Reset.

One GitHub signal per day, 5-minute exercise per day. Personal sourcing framework from public data, no tool required.

From the SSRN methodology (abstract=6606558).

signals.gitdealflow.com/challenge

EU + LATAM seed-stage are under-covered in venture data tooling.

This week's Acceleration Watch names: AtroCore (EU +38%), Kanvas (LATAM +32%), metasfresh (EU +139%).

signals.gitdealflow.com/predicted
